definitions: simple past and past participle of mystify

blocks.text: Mystified is the debut EP by Joe Scarborough, released on June 23, 2017. With five tracks, the EP is in the alternative and indie genre.
Mystified is a 2019 Philippine fantasy film, directed and written by Mark A. Reyes, starring Iza Calzado, Karylle, Sunshine Dizon and Diana Zubiri. It was released on March 29, 2019, on iflix.
